'''Corellian credits''' were a unit of currency on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] made a bet of one hundred Corellian credits to an officer on the ''[[Mon Remonda/Legends|Mon Remonda]]''.
